name: HELMET_D455_CHARUCO_7X5_50MM

board_coordinate_frame.origin: outer bottom-left corner of the 350 x 250 mm printed chessboard pattern, following the OpenCV ChArUco board convention
board_coordinate_frame.y_axis: up along the five-square direction when viewing the printed face upright
board_coordinate_frame.z_axis: out of the printed face toward the camera
board_coordinate_frame.warning: task_from_board must be physically measured using this canonical board frame; the printed page top-left and raw OpenCV detector frame are not the calibrated board-frame origin

opencv_detector_frame_conversion.opencv_frame: outer top-left; +X right; +Y down; +Z into the printed face
opencv_detector_frame_conversion.canonical_frame: outer bottom-left; +X right; +Y up; +Z out of the printed face

physical_verification: print on dimensionally stable A3 media at actual size / 100 percent
measure the full black-white pattern as 350.0 x 250.0 mm before use
reject the print if either dimension differs by more than 0.5 mm
mount the sheet flat; do not bend it around the workspace frame
